FRANK_V0_1.label: Frank v0.1
FRANK_V0_1.completion_law: PASS only when the exact accepted self.root/Frank v0.1 binary/state identity is running on the accepted target VPS and satisfies the current finished-v0.1 acceptance contract. ClayCode, UnifiedDB, GWT, Hyperposition, Retina/MVC, Needle/translator, API, effect authority, proactive agency, security/recovery and model work are component obligations of this single gate.

superseded_stage_model.law: These identifiers may appear in historical receipts/workspaces and can contribute evidence to current Frank v0.1 component work, but they are not active programme stages or release targets.

progress_semantics.formula: 100 * completed_subcheck_weight / total_subcheck_weight where subchecks exist, otherwise completed_work_package_weight / total_work_package_weight
progress_semantics.rule: Visible programme progress is Frank v0.1 progress. No separate GitHub/Reference/Clay Harness or H1/H2/H3 progress block exists.

trigger_target_rule: Every registered trigger is a specialized research/build/test lens on FRANK_V0_1 and must re-enter code/tests/architecture/work/negative-results for Frank v0.1.
training_rule: Final paid/model training remains blocked until explicit project-owner authorization. Training-data preparation and bounded runtime learning allowed by existing contracts may proceed as Frank v0.1 component work.
